from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialDataPoint(BaseModel):
    """One financial figure extracted from a company report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company whose report this is")
    financial_item: str | None = Field(description="The name of the financial line item (e.g., '一年内到期的非流动负债')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the item")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency, usually '人民币元' for Chinese reports")
    period_label: str | None = Field(description="Reporting period label (e.g., '2024年第一季度期末')")
    position: str | None = Field(description="Whether amount is start or end of period, e.g., '期末余额' or '期初余额'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_data_points: list[FinancialDataPoint]
